mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_lab_alias (alias, field, sample_name, doctor_id) VALUES (#{alias}, #{field}, #{sampleName}, #{doctorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE field = VALUES(field), sample_name = VALUES(sample_name), doctor_id = VALUES(doctor_id)
INSERT INTO ocr_record (file_id, doctor_id, upload_time) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{doctorId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_record SET result = #{result}, recognize_time = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, doctor_id AS doctorId, patient_id AS patientId, visit_id AS visitId FROM ocr_record WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND research_type IN ()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_follow_up_history WHERE id = #{visitId} AND patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND research_type IN ()

SELECT r.file_id AS fileId, DATE_FORMAT(r.upload_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS uploadTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.recognize_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS recognizeTime FROM ocr_record r WHERE r.visit_id = #{visitId} AND r.patient_id = #{patientId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_relation_doctor d WHERE d.patient_id = r.patient_id AND d.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND d.research_type IN ()) ORDER BY r.id
